This build accepts local dataset paths only. DeepSWE-style usage therefore starts from a converted/exported task directory.

Pier does not ship a first-party DeepSWE downloader in the inspected build. The dataset must already exist locally in Harbor-style task form.

Pier is best read as execution and analysis infrastructure for coding-agent benchmarks, not as a benchmark corpus itself.

Use Pier when you want native agent CLIs, filtered-network sandboxes, and high-quality normalized trajectories.
